text: so i started with a staircase, and i have edited it to here, but how do i export this ? [Image #5]
resolution: User seeded a staircase, added a curved railing, and asked how to export it. Answered the how-to (the gold Package/Compile icon in the Studio toolbar → Compile Asset dialog → Label + Nature + Piece type → Cook + Install; the whole visible model flattens into one cooked piece with a mesh-measured footprint). Noticed the Piece type picker (req_1698) lacked a Stairs option even though the user built a staircase, so added 'Stairs' (pieceKind:'stairs', grid snap) to COMPILE_PLACEMENTS in both the live studiokit CompileAssetDialog and the Studio.tsx twin — so a cooked staircase lists under stairs in the placed-piece swap pick and can replace a stock staircase. StudioViewport bundles clean. Needs a dev re-bundle for the new Stairs option to appear; the user can export now with the existing types (Railing fits too). Asked whether they want the whole thing as Stairs or the railing as a separate swappable piece. Sha ef0bd1e3b.
